description: Authoritative routing, output, and effort policy for the Antigravity Skills Suite. AGENTS.md and GEMINI.md reference this file. Skills validate against it via scripts/validate-skills.py.

intermediate_pipeline_stage.format: one milestone heartbeat only when useful

engineering_blueprint.format: data flow + tech stack + data model + API and 4 UI states

execution_plan.format: plan artifact with concise chat summary where supported

quick.description: Smallest relevant workflow, targeted checks, no optional visual/council work

standard.description: Scoped planning, relevant verification, bounded optional exploration

thorough.description: Broader review and verification for high-risk work; explicit additional budgets

invariants: An explicit blueprint request receives all 5 core engineering decisions in any effort profile
Effort profiles do not override manual activation or host limitations
Do not claim token or cost limits are enforced unless telemetry and enforcement exist
A prior explicit implementation request does not require another approval when a skill changes stage
An explicitly requested specialist may load reference files but must not start a council, publish, or create workers

token_targets.note: Review targets only — not reasons to delete safeguards or truncate the 24-section spec
